title: A Rat Found 71 Landmines and Won a Gold Medal

scenes.text: A rat found 71 landmines and won a gold medal.
His name was Magawa, a giant pouched rat working in Cambodia.
He spent five years sniffing out landmines.
He found 71 mines and 38 other unexploded bombs.
He helped clear about 141,000 square meters, around 20 soccer fields.
A British charity gave him its gold medal for animal bravery.

description:
A rat named Magawa found 71 landmines in Cambodia.
He also found 38 other unexploded bombs and cleared about 20 soccer fields of land.
Which animal hero deserves a medal next?
first_comment: Small rat, huge hero. Which animal deserves a medal next?
